nodes.label: executable.Main
nodes.desc: main() extracts winstone.jar from the WAR, loads winstone.Launcher and hands over servlet startup.

nodes.label: Jenkins
nodes.desc: Root singleton (5,321 lines); Jenkins.get(), createProject(), getExtensionList() all live here.

nodes.label: PluginManager
nodes.desc: Loads plugin jars into an uberClassLoader and drives the plugin lifecycle.

nodes.label: UpdateCenter
nodes.desc: Signed-metadata update center that schedules plugin install and update jobs.

nodes.label: Item
nodes.desc: Base interface for every persistence root living under the controller.

nodes.label: ItemGroup
nodes.desc: Container interface that lets items nest other items, e.g. folders.

nodes.label: Job
nodes.desc: A buildable item that owns run history and health reporting.

nodes.label: AbstractProject
nodes.desc: BuildableItem with scheduleBuild2(), quiet period fallback and makeDisabled().

nodes.label: FreeStyleProject
nodes.desc: Concrete classic project; DescriptorImpl registered with @Extension(ordinal = 1000) and Symbols.

nodes.label: Descriptor
nodes.desc: Metadata singleton for configurable classes; descriptors are collected via ExtensionList.

nodes.label: Run
nodes.desc: One recorded execution of a Job: result, log, artifacts and actions.

nodes.label: AbstractBuild
nodes.desc: Run + Queue.Executable with a workspace; AbstractBuildExecution.run() calls doRun().

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.desc: Global queue extending ResourceController; schedule2() in, maintain() transitioning, pop() out.

nodes.label: SubTask
nodes.desc: Unit of scheduling; createExecutable() materializes the actual work.

nodes.label: WorkUnit
nodes.desc: One executor slot assignment created from a SubTask by MappingWorksheet.

nodes.label: ScheduleResult
nodes.desc: Refused, Existing or Created outcome returned by schedule2().

nodes.label: QueueSorter
nodes.desc: Extension point that reorders waiting and buildable items before dispatch.

nodes.label: CauseOfBlockage
nodes.desc: Human-readable reason an item sits in the blocked stage.

nodes.label: QueueListener
nodes.desc: Extension point firing on every queue state transition.

nodes.label: Executor
nodes.desc: Thread per slot; run() grabs a WorkUnit under queue lock and calls createExecutable().

nodes.label: Computer
nodes.desc: Per-node runtime state: isOnline(), countIdle(), getExecutors().

nodes.label: WorkspaceList
nodes.desc: Lease-based allocation of build workspace directories per node.

nodes.label: ExtensionPoint
nodes.desc: Marker interface declaring a pluggable seam; 100+ implementors in core alone.

nodes.label: ExtensionList
nodes.desc: CopyOnWrite-backed list per ExtensionPoint type, lazily filled by ensureLoaded().

nodes.label: ExtensionFinder
nodes.desc: Extension point that discovers @Extension-annotated classes on the classpath and in plugins.

nodes.label: Trigger
nodes.desc: Extension point for periodic and event-driven scheduling, e.g. cron timers.

nodes.label: SCM
nodes.desc: Extension point abstracting source control systems and their checkout behavior.

nodes.label: Builder
nodes.desc: Extension point for build steps executed inside the run.

nodes.label: CLI client
nodes.desc: Client that connects via FullDuplexHttpStream over the cli?remoting=false endpoint.

nodes.label: CLICommand
nodes.desc: Abstract command implementing ExtensionPoint and Cloneable; run() executes server-side.

nodes.label: FullDuplexHttpStream
nodes.desc: Tunnels a bidirectional byte stream through two HTTP requests.

nodes.label: AgentProtocol
nodes.desc: Extension point for inbound agent connection protocols.

install and update jobs run here
top-level item group over persisted items
explains why an item is blocked

leases a workspace directory per build

maintainer thread owned by the controller
